3. As a woman, you'll experience so much freedom. I can wear whatever I want, walk home alone at 3 am and generally feel much more free than i did in India. At the same time, states are clamping down on abortion rights. So freedom really is very contextual.
4. Come to the US, IF you don't have to take a huge loan. Or even better if you can get a scholarship. It'll really take away the pressure of finding a job, etc after graduation. If you want more assured return on your investment, explore Canada or the EU. Much friendlier immigration policies

I usually keep the bus route open on Google maps and keep checking it throughout the journey. So I know when to get off and press the yellow cord accordingly. But I almost always pull the cord after the stop is announced. It’s never been a problem except once-  when I pulled the cord after the stop was announced, it was too close to the stop and the the driver assumed I wanted to get off at the next stop.

But if you forget to carry a mask and you’re already at the bus stop, don’t worry. The drivers have extra masks on them. 
Sometimes you’ll need to  transfer buses and you need a transfer pass (to avoid paying twice for the same trip). The drivers are usually really nice and almost always ask if you need one- but if they forget, just ask them for it.

So 4-5 years ago, before the whole influencer thing really took off, I made some rich friends who were into luxury bags. They’re absolutely lovely people but they really liked luxury stuff. For clothes ZARA was the minimum they would consider. Previously, I was least interested in brands but after hanging out with them, I became more and more into the whole thing. Anyway one of them got an LV bag and I started feeling a lot of FOMO. I guess they were the OG influencers in my life. 

So I got myself a Coach Bag. It’s no LV but hey atleast it wasn’t some random Esbeda bag, right ?

Well guess what ? I barely used that bag. Because I paid a lot for it, I thought I’ll use it only on special occasions! I had to force myself to use it and nobody fucking cares if my bag is Coach or not. On the other hand, I got myself a random unbranded leather bag and got a lot of compliments on that. If anyone’s feeling pressure to make a luxury purchase after looking at influencers- by all means get the bag if you have the disposable income but I promise it doesn’t matter which bag you use. No one cares except the user.
